name: Git activity
description: The branch's recent commits beside Diff and Files, and how far it is ahead of its upstream in the status bar. Shell commands only.

statusItems.label: Commits ahead
statusItems.command: n=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null) && [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && printf '\357\201\242 %s ahead\nCommits on this branch not pushed yet. Click to see them.\n' "$n" || true
